intents.response: BVC Engineering College admissions are based on AP EAPCET counseling and management quota. The standard tuition fee is approximately Rs. 45,000 per semester. For detailed admission criteria and management quota inquiries, please visit the main administration block during working hours.

We regularly host massive 24-hour hackathons! You can view upcoming hackathons in the 'Events' section of the portal. During registration, you must specify your domain (like AI, Web, App Dev) and provide a pitch. Teams are usually formed on the spot or pre-registered.

The syllabus is dynamic and depends on your branch. Currently, our advanced curriculum covers AI, Full Stack Development, Cloud Computing, and IoT. To check the exact subjects for your class, please check the Timetable section or the official academic digital portal.

BVC Engineering College (BVCITS), located in Odalarevu, is a premier technical institution. We offer state-of-the-art facilities, excellent placements in MNCs, and an advanced AI-integrated learning environment. Our vision is to empower students through cutting-edge technology.

The college administration includes our respected Principal, Deans, and Department HODs. The main administrative office is located in Block-A on the ground floor. If you have specific inquiries, please contact the helpdesk.

Our placement cell is highly active! We have seen packages up to 44 LPA with companies like Amazon, Microsoft, and TCS visiting regularly. Check the Placements section on the dashboard for upcoming drives.
The Central Library is located on the 2nd Floor. You can check book availability and your current fines through the Library section in this portal. Issued books must be returned within 14 days.
We provide GPS-enabled smart transport across multiple routes including Kakinada, Amalapuram, and Rajahmundry. You can track your bus live and check ETA in the Transport section.
Semester results and your overall CGPA can be viewed in the Results section using your Roll Number and a secure OTP. The system automatically charts your academic progress.
Your class schedule is managed by our AI Timetable Engine. You can view your specific section's daily timetable by clicking the Timetable app on the dashboard.

BVC Engineering College (Odalarevu) was established in 1997 under the BVC Educational Society. It is an autonomous institute affiliated with JNTU Kakinada (JNTUK), approved by AICTE, and accredited by NAAC. The sprawling green campus is located in Odalarevu, Allavaram Mandal, East Godavari (Andhra Pradesh - 533210). It has 25+ years of educational service, 7 undergraduate B.Tech branches, a highest salary package of 14 LPA, and 30+ annual corporate recruiters.

The institution offers B.Tech (4 Years) in CSE, AI&ML, AI&DS, ECE, EEE, ME, and CE. Postgraduate Programs (2 Years) include M.Tech in CSE, VLSI & Embedded Systems, Thermal Engineering, Power Electronics, and MCA. It also offers 3-Year Polytechnic Diploma programs in CSE, ECE, EEE, CE, and ME.

Admissions follow APSCHE and JNTUK guidelines. B.Tech (1st Year) requires AP EAPCET/JEE Main and 10+2 with Math, Physics & Chemistry (45%+ aggregate). B.Tech (Lateral) requires AP ECET and a Diploma/B.Sc. M.Tech requires AP PGECET/GATE and a B.Tech/B.E. MCA requires AP ICET and a Bachelor's Degree. Diploma requires AP POLYCET and 10th Class (SSC) pass.

The Training and Placement Cell (TPC) prepares students from the 2nd year, focusing on Technical Skills, Aptitude, and Soft Skills. Top Placement Partners include IT Services (TCS, DXC, Tech Mahindra, HCL, Mphasis, Wipro), Product & Software (Virtusa, Covalense, Miracle, Hexaware), and Core Sector infrastructure firms.

Campus amenities include high-speed Computing & Internet, a Central Library with NDLI membership, AICTE-standard Departmental Laboratories, secure Residential Hostels for male and female students with dining and security, a fleet of buses for Transport, and extensive Sports & Student Welfare facilities (cricket, volleyball, basketball, athletics, indoor gym, health center).
